title: Quaint Crumbly Brazilian Cheese Pilaf
description: A traditional Brazilian dish featuring a crumbly texture and grassy flavors, this pilaf is a nostalgic delight, made with satvik-friendly ingredients and a touch of spherified magic.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped scallions and cook until they are softened and fragrant.
Add the cooked brown rice to the skillet, stirring to combine with the scallions and oil.
Stir in the crumbled Brazilian cheese until it is well combined with the rice mixture.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
In a small bowl, mix the sodium alginate with a small amount of water to create a spherification bath.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the cheese and rice mixture into the spherification bath, creating small spheres.
Let the spheres sit in the bath for about 30 seconds to set, then remove them with a slotted spoon.
Serve the quaint crumbly Brazilian cheese pilaf hot, garnished with additional chopped scallions if desired.
